boundary: Edge and synthetic bridge/catalog only; not native PhotoKit, ads or StoreKit validation

results.name: favorite: stale manual snapshot cannot undo a confirmed favorite
catalog empty: no unavailable purchase buttons or coming-soon claims
favorite undo: old favored snapshot cannot restore an undone favorite
favorite failure: neither history nor Photos fixture claims success
catalog error and retry: only available real IDs are offered
purchase cancelled: confirmation follows the bridge result
purchase pending: confirmation follows the bridge result
purchase error: confirmation follows the bridge result
purchase purchased: confirmation follows the bridge result
restore failure is never presented as restored
